import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
from collections import Counter
from textblob import TextBlob
from matplotlib import pyplot as plt

def task_func(text, n, top_k):
    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():
        return None
    if n <= 0 or top_k <= 0:
        return None
        
    blob = TextBlob(text)
    ngrams_list = blob.ngrams(n=n)
    
    if not ngrams_list:
        return None
        
    ngram_strings = [" ".join(ngram) for ngram in ngrams_list]
    counts = Counter(ngram_strings)
    most_common = counts.most_common(top_k)
    
    if not most_common:
        return None
        
    df = pd.DataFrame(most_common, columns=['N-gram', 'Frequency'])
    
    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
    sns.barplot(x='Frequency', y='N-gram', data=df)
    plt.title(f'Top {top_k} {n}-grams')
    plt.tight_layout()
    
    return None
